vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Edit audiobook dialogue against approved scripts while preserving clear review notes.
requirements.zh: 依据获批脚本编辑有声书对白，同时保留清晰审核记录。

requirements.en: Maintain timecoded pickup requests and accurate chapter-delivery records.
requirements.zh: 维护带时间码的补录请求及准确章节交付记录。

requirements.en: Use a digital audio workstation and distinguish final programme duration from the duration of raw recordings.
requirements.zh: 使用数字音频工作站，并区分最终节目时长与原始录音时长。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently master distribution audio and approve final delivery levels.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立制作发行母带，并批准最终交付电平。
